entities.summary: Lorcia Emmarslade Cooper-Khumalo is a South African actress and dancer. She is best known for her roles in the popular television serials Backstage, Scandal!, Lockdown (2017-2020) and Red Ink (2024), and in films Hey Boy (2003) and Zulu Wedding (2017).
